//: Weak competition for 'test Y2038 on Windows' - forum threads that say 'set the system date to 2038', which on a real machine breaks TLS and the domain. The page is honest that Windows' own clock is 64-bit and says where the 32-bit bug can still live (Microsoft's documented time_t, int and long behaviour). The commands pin the zone to +00:00 because the limit is defined in UTC and --at is read in the session zone.
